name: Bani
overview: Bani is a male member of the tribe of Levi noted in Nehemiah 9:4 as one of the Levites who stood on the Levites' platform during a significant assembly. Beyond this unique attribute, Scripture does not provide additional personal details or notes about him.
namesAndTitles: The name Bani means "descendant," reflecting a proper name without indication of being directly given by God. This meaning aligns with his identification as a descendant of Levi.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records Bani as a descendant of Levi, confirming his Levitical lineage. No further family relationships are detailed beyond this tribal connection.
scriptureSignificance: Bani's significance lies in his role as one of the Levites who participated in a key religious gathering, standing on the Levites' platform as recorded in Nehemiah 9:4. This placement highlights his involvement in the worship and leadership functions of the Levites during the post-exilic period. His presence underscores the continuity of Levitical service in Israel's restoration.
